title: How to Redeem Your API Credits
excerpt: A step-by-step guide to turning your redemption code into usable API credits.

content.p: After completing your purchase you will see a redemption code on the confirmation page. It looks like ONEAPI-XXXXXX and is unique to your order. Save it somewhere safe ✉️.

content.caption: Turning a redemption code into usable credits

content.h: Open the panel and log in 👤

content.p: Visit the One API panel and log in. If you do not have an account yet, create one in a few seconds with just a username and password.
In the account menu, open the Redemption page. Paste your redemption code into the input and press the Redeem button. The credits are added to your balance instantly ⚡.
Open the Token page and create a new token. Copy the token string and use it as your API key when calling the OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

list: Models: any model available on your account

content.p: That is it. Your credits never expire, so you can use them whenever you need 💙.

faq.a: Credits appear on your account instantly after you press Redeem — there is no waiting period.

faq.q: What if my code does not work?
faq.a: Check for extra spaces or a typo first. If it still fails, contact support with your order number and we will sort it out.
No, credits never expire. You can keep them for as long as you need.

faq.q: Can I split one code across multiple accounts?
faq.a: No. Each redemption code can be used only once and credits go to the account that redeems it.
